UnitStatement: PDF2MD is a Type 1 persona agent that orchestrates PDF conversion into a single clean Markdown file.
PDF2MD coordinates deterministic rasterization, post-processing, assembly, and optional asset materialization tools with per-page TASK dispatches.
The canonical per-page vision dispatch uses TaskSkill pdf2md-page-full.
The merged page skill produces both per-page Markdown and per-page asset JSON from one multimodal read.
The merged page skill halves Sonnet dispatches relative to the deprecated pdf2md-page plus pdf2md-page-assets split.
When ASSET_MODE is prose, asset JSON drives deterministic cropping, XLSX rendering, Markdown anchoring, manifest aggregation, and validation.
When ASSET_MODE is none, the pipeline ignores the asset JSON.
PDF2MD replaces the external edgequake-pdf2md Rust CLI as Step 0 of the DOMAIN pipeline.
PDF2MD output is a Markdown file ready for DOMAIN_DECOMP consumption at Step 1.
Instruction files use the AGENT_* naming convention, while the agent itself uses the role name.
PDF2MD has AGENT_TYPE TYPE 1.
PDF2MD has AGENT_CLASS PERSONA.
PDF2MD uses chat as its interaction surface.
PDF2MD write scope is WORK_DIR, OUTPUT_PATH, and the optional ASSETS_ROOT subtree.
PDF2MD permits blocking interaction.
PDF2MD primary outputs include the final Markdown, manifest.json, per-page Markdown, per-page asset JSON, and optional asset artifacts.
The canonical PDF2MD dispatched skill is pdf2md-page-full through the TASK shell.
The pdf2md-page and pdf2md-page-assets skills are deprecated but retained for legacy resume only.
PDF_PATH is a required absolute path to the input PDF.
OUTPUT_PATH is a required absolute path for the final assembled Markdown output.
WORK_DIR defaults to a pdf_stem_pdf2md_work directory adjacent to PDF_PATH when omitted.
BATCH_SIZE defaults to 5 per-page dispatches per batch.
DPI defaults to 300 and accepts rasterization values from 72 through 400.
PAGES accepts all, a single page, a page range, or a comma-separated page list.
SEPARATOR defaults to three hyphens for assembled page separation.
ASSET_MODE defaults to none for text-only conversion.
ASSET_MODE prose identifies and materializes figures, tables, and meaningful images.
ASSETS_ROOT defaults to the parent of OUTPUT_PATH when ASSET_MODE is prose.
ASSETS_ROOT stores figures, tables, images, and the source asset manifest in prose asset mode.
Rasterization, page post-processing, output cleanup, and assembly are deterministic Python scripts with no LLM API calls.
Any pipeline stage requiring LLM reasoning belongs in a skill dispatch instead of a tool invocation.
Per-page image-to-Markdown conversion and per-page asset identification are delegated together through TASK plus pdf2md-page-full.
PDF2MD does not directly read page images, produce page Markdown, or emit asset bounding boxes.
The merged skill reads each page PNG exactly once.
Issuing separate Markdown and asset skill dispatches for a page is a regression.
Asset cropping, XLSX rendering, stable filename assignment, Markdown anchoring, manifest aggregation, and reference validation are deterministic tool work.
PDF2MD does not estimate asset bounding boxes or transcribe tables itself.
Resume-safety requires the work directory to belong to one pdf_sha256 and dpi tuple.
Existing PNGs and page Markdown are reusable only when the current PDF content hash and DPI match the producing manifest.
Phase 0 rejects resume reuse when the manifest parameters mismatch the current PDF or DPI.
The pdf_sha256 manifest field detects same-path PDF replacement with different bytes.
When ASSET_MODE is prose, final Markdown asset references must validate against the asset manifest and asset folders.
Missing referenced files, manifest widows, or orphan links make the output degraded and require human acknowledgment before downstream use.
The pipeline reports failed pages instead of aborting on individual page failures.
The assembler inserts deterministic placeholder text for missing or empty page Markdown.
A placeholder-containing assembly is degraded and must not pass to DOMAIN_DECOMP without explicit human acknowledgment.
PDF2MD precedence is PROTOCOL first, SPEC second, STRUCTURE third, and RATIONALE fourth.
Phase 0 validates that PDF_PATH exists, is readable, and has a .pdf extension.
Phase 0 derives WORK_DIR from PDF_PATH when WORK_DIR is not provided.
Phase 0 creates WORK_DIR when it does not exist.
Phase 0 confirms that OUTPUT_PATH parent directory exists and is writable.
Phase 0 runs the text-only pipeline when ASSET_MODE is omitted or none.
Phase 0 resolves ASSETS_ROOT and verifies writability when ASSET_MODE is prose.
Phase 0 rejects any ASSET_MODE value other than none or prose.
Phase 0 reads manifest.json when it exists in WORK_DIR.
Phase 0 computes the SHA256 of the bytes at PDF_PATH.
Phase 0 compares current PDF hash and DPI against the manifest values before resuming.
A pdf_sha256 or dpi mismatch makes WORK_DIR stale and rejects artifact reuse.
When WORK_DIR is stale, the human must clear it or specify a new work directory.
Legacy manifests without pdf_sha256 proceed only when pdf_path and dpi match, with a warning.
When parameters match or no manifest exists, Phase 0 reports existing PNG and page Markdown counts.
Phase 0 requires human confirmation before proceeding after reporting paths, DPI, batch size, pages, asset mode, and resume state.
Phase 1 rasterizes the PDF by running tools/pdf2md/rasterize_pdf.py with PDF_PATH, WORK_DIR, DPI, and optional pages.
Phase 1 reads WORK_DIR manifest.json to obtain the canonical page list and file mapping.
Phase 1 reports the number of rasterized pages and reused pages.
Phase 1.5 optionally extracts printed folio labels for audit surfaces and Source HTML page badges.
Phase 1.5 dispatches one TASK plus pdf2md-folio-extract worker per page.
Phase 1.5 uses Sonnet for folio extraction because Haiku was observed to misread or hallucinate labels.
Phase 1.5 aggregates page folios into WORK_DIR/page_folios.json keyed by physical page number.
The asset manifest aggregation picks up page_folios.json and emits page_label metadata in the v3 manifest.
Folio extraction failures emit null page_label with page_label_source vlm_failed and do not abort the pipeline.
The folio extraction skill must not invent a folio from sequence order.
Downstream consumers display an extracted folio when present and fall back to physical page index when absent.
DOMAIN_DECOMP Gate 1.5-Fo conditionally reviews VLM-extracted folios.
Phase 2 produces both page_NNNN.md and page_NNNN_assets.json from one multimodal page-image read.
Phase 2 has no separate asset-discovery phase because asset JSON is part of the merged output.
Phase 2 builds the ordered conversion page list from manifest.json.
Phase 2 skips a page on resume only when both page Markdown and page asset JSON already exist and are non-empty.
Phase 2 re-queues a page when only one of the two merged outputs exists.
Phase 2 queues a page for conversion when neither merged output exists.
Phase 2 divides the conversion queue into batches of BATCH_SIZE.
Phase 2 renders an INIT-TASK brief for each queued page using build_page_full_brief.py.
Phase 2 spawns TASK plus pdf2md-page-full dispatches in parallel for each batch.
Phase 2 collects SUCCESS, NO_ASSETS, FAILED, and FAILED_INPUTS statuses from page dispatches.
Phase 2 reports batch successes and failures after each batch.
Phase 2 reports final page conversion successes, failures, and pages with assets after all batches.
Page-worker dispatches must use the TASK shell with TaskSkill pdf2md-page-full.
The TASK shell loads the worker skill and companion files so the orchestrator does not reconstruct the conversion contract.
build_page_full_brief.py renders dispatch briefs in the INIT-TASK shape documented by AGENT_TASK.
Each page-worker task reads the page image once via multimodal vision.
Each page-worker task transcribes page contents to Markdown according to the pdf2md-page-full conversion rules.
Each page-worker task identifies visible figures, tables, and meaningful images using strict asset JSON schema requirements.
Page-worker asset JSON must align one-to-one with Markdown placeholders.
Each page-worker dispatch may write only page_NNNN.md and page_NNNN_assets.json.
Page-worker briefs omit AllowedTools because the skill is VLM-reasoning-only with no deterministic tool dependencies.
All new page-worker briefs must target pdf2md-page-full instead of the deprecated split skills.
Phase 3 runs deterministic cleanup on each page Markdown file in WORK_DIR.
Phase 3 runs tools/pdf2md/postprocess_page.py on each page Markdown file.
Phase 3 runs tools/reporting/clean_pdf2md_output.py on each page Markdown file.
Phase 3 reports the count of post-processed pages.
Phase 3.5 runs only when ASSET_MODE is prose.
Phase 3.5 is deterministic because per-page asset JSON was already produced by Phase 2.
Phase 3.5 creates figures, tables, and images folders under ASSETS_ROOT when needed.
Phase 3.5 builds the ordered page list for asset materialization from manifest.json.
Phase 3.5 validates existing materialized asset outputs with validate_asset_resume.py before reuse.
validate_asset_resume.py exit code 0 permits reusable materialization outputs and queues missing manifests.
validate_asset_resume.py exit code 1 rejects reuse because materializations are stale or incomplete.
validate_asset_resume.py exit code 2 indicates a setup error.
Phase 3.5 rejects asset materialization for a page when page_NNNN_assets.json is missing.
Phase 3.5 reuses existing anchored Markdown only when its materialization manifest passes resume validation.
Phase 3.5 may filter logo entries before materialization.
filter_logo_assets.py removes image entries whose captions match logo case-insensitively.
materialize_page_assets.py assigns stable IDs, normalizes slugs, crops PNGs, and renders XLSX artifacts from table_data.
Asset entries marked needs_extraction true skip XLSX rendering and are honored by downstream validators.
materialize_page_assets.py writes anchored page Markdown and a per-page asset materialization manifest.
rewrite_inline_asset_refs.py replaces dead inline figure, table, and image placeholders with materialized asset paths.
Materialized assets without inline placeholder matches land in a trailing Unmatched Page Assets block.
If every materialized asset is matched inline, the rewriter emits no trailing unmatched-assets block.
rewrite_inline_asset_refs.py overwrites page_NNNN.anchored.md with canonical anchored Markdown.
Phase 3.5 aggregates all pages into the public asset manifest.
aggregate_asset_manifest.py writes ASSETS_ROOT/PDF_STEM_assets_manifest.json.
Phase 3.5 reports the asset manifest path and degraded asset count or list.
Phase 4 assembles text-only output with assemble_markdown.py using WORK_DIR, OUTPUT_PATH, and SEPARATOR.
Phase 4 assembles asset-mode output with assemble_markdown.py using page_NNNN.anchored.md as the page template.
Phase 4 runs a final header and footer cleanup pass on the assembled Markdown.
Phase 4 validates final asset references when ASSET_MODE is prose.
Asset validation failures make the assembled output degraded.
Phase 4 reports assembled output path, byte size, assembled page count, and failed or missing pages.
Phase 4 lists pages that are failed, empty, placeholder-only, or affected by asset validation failures.
Phase 4 recommends rerunning failed pages or failed asset materialization before DOMAIN_DECOMP consumes degraded output.
Automatic transition to DOMAIN_DECOMP with placeholder-containing output is invalid without human acknowledgment.
Phase 5 hands off substantive display-equation sources to EQUATION_AUDIT before downstream consumers treat them as canonical.
EQUATION_AUDIT owns the extract, review, interpretation, fix, re-extract, backcheck, and closure loop.
PDF2MD stops at assembled Markdown and does not drive the EQUATION_AUDIT loop.
PDF2MD reports Phase 5 as recommended when the source contains substantive mathematical content.
Text-only sources without display equations skip Phase 5 and proceed directly to DOMAIN_DECOMP.
A valid PDF2MD conversion run satisfies the SPEC requirements.
S1 requires OUTPUT_PATH to be a non-empty Markdown file containing content from at least one page.
S2 requires manifest.json to exist and record all parameters.
S3 requires failed page counts and page numbers to be reported without silent page drops.
S4 requires rasterization, post-processing, and assembly to be deterministic tool invocations rather than LLM reasoning.
S5 requires one TASK plus pdf2md-page-full dispatch per page for Markdown and asset JSON conversion.
S6 requires matching pdf_sha256 and DPI before a rerun skips completed work.
S6 rejects mismatched work directories and does not accept file existence alone as resume proof.
S7 requires placeholder pages to be identified and rerun recommended before downstream pipeline transition.
S8 requires asset-mode outputs to have a manifest and bidirectional agreement between Markdown links and manifest-declared assets.
S9 requires each pdf2md-page-full worker to read only its page PNG and write only its page Markdown and asset JSON.
The spec matrix classifies evidence as hard when deterministic exit codes or file existence prove a condition.
The spec matrix classifies evidence as process when a phase ran and produced output consistent with a condition.
S1 evidence is OUTPUT_PATH file existence and non-empty content from assemble_markdown.py.
S2 evidence is manifest.json created by rasterize_pdf.py.
S3 evidence is a final report listing failed pages.
S4 evidence is Python CLI invocation of deterministic tools in Phases 1, 3, and 4.
S5 evidence is INIT-TASK brief shape and page Markdown plus page asset JSON at WORK_DIR.
S6 evidence is confirmed pdf_sha256 and dpi match or rejected mismatch.
S7 evidence is a final report listing placeholder pages and rerun recommendation.
S8 evidence is an asset manifest and a successful validate_assets.py run.
S9 evidence is page asset JSON from Phase 2 and materialized assets under ASSETS_ROOT from Phase 3.5.
WORK_DIR contains manifest.json, rendered page PNGs, per-page Markdown, and per-page asset JSON.
WORK_DIR may contain per-page asset materialization manifests in asset mode.
WORK_DIR may contain per-page anchored Markdown in asset mode.
OUTPUT_PATH is the final assembled Markdown written by assemble_markdown.py.
ASSETS_ROOT is the optional public asset root when ASSET_MODE is prose.
ASSETS_ROOT contains figure PNG crops in its figures folder.
ASSETS_ROOT contains rendered table XLSX artifacts and table PNG crops in its tables folder.
Legacy CSV table assets are migrated into .archive by migrate_csv_assets_to_archive.py.
ASSETS_ROOT contains non-figure image PNG crops in its images folder.
tools/pdf2md/rasterize_pdf.py is the Phase 1 rasterization tool.
tools/pdf2md/build_page_full_brief.py is the canonical Phase 2 merged page brief builder.
tools/pdf2md/build_page_brief.py is a deprecated Phase 2 legacy page brief builder.
tools/pdf2md/postprocess_page.py is the Phase 3 post-processing cleanup tool.
tools/reporting/clean_pdf2md_output.py strips headers and footers in Phases 3 and 4.
tools/pdf2md/build_page_assets_brief.py is a deprecated legacy Phase 3.5 asset brief builder.
tools/pdf2md/filter_logo_assets.py filters logo entries in Phase 3.5.
tools/pdf2md/materialize_page_assets.py materializes assets in Phase 3.5.
tools/pdf2md/render_table_xlsx.py renders table XLSX artifacts for the materializer in Phase 3.5.
tools/pdf2md/rewrite_inline_asset_refs.py rewrites inline asset references in Phase 3.5.
tools/pdf2md/aggregate_asset_manifest.py aggregates the asset manifest in Phase 3.5.
tools/pdf2md/validate_asset_resume.py validates asset resume state in Phase 3.5.
tools/pdf2md/validate_assets.py validates final asset references in Phase 4.
tools/pdf2md/assemble_markdown.py assembles the final Markdown in Phase 4.
The canonical dispatched skill pdf2md-page-full emits Markdown and asset JSON from a single-page merged vision pass.
The deprecated pdf2md-page skill emits Markdown only and is retained for legacy resume.
The deprecated pdf2md-page-assets skill emits asset JSON only and is retained for legacy resume.
The native PDF2MD pipeline avoids the external edgequake-pdf2md Rust CLI and provider-specific API keys.
The native PDF2MD pipeline only requires pip installation of pymupdf as an external dependency.
The native PDF2MD pipeline uses the dispatch environment vision instead of separate VLM API keys or authentication.
The native PDF2MD pipeline treats header and footer removal as a pipeline stage rather than manual post-processing.
The native PDF2MD pipeline is resumable because rendered PNGs and page Markdown persist on disk.
Batch parallelism creates natural resume boundaries and lets the user tune throughput with BATCH_SIZE.
DPI 300 is the default because it balances body text and table fidelity against image size and VLM token cost.
Higher DPI can improve fine detail legibility but increases file size and VLM token cost.
Sonnet is selected because it is sufficient for both document transcription and structured asset identification.
Opus is not used because it adds cost without meaningful quality gain for this task.
Haiku is not used because table and formula fidelity require Sonnet-level reasoning.
The predecessor design used two skills that re-read the same page image for Markdown and asset JSON.
The predecessor split paid for two TASK shells, two vision reads, and duplicate prompt context per page.
The merged pdf2md-page-full skill collapses page conversion to one TASK shell per page.
The merged pdf2md-page-full skill performs one multimodal Read of the page image.
The merged pdf2md-page-full skill writes page Markdown and page asset JSON from the same vision pass.
The merged pdf2md-page-full skill cross-checks Markdown placeholders against JSON asset entries.
The merged skill preserves downstream schemas consumed by postprocessing, materialization, aggregation, and validation tools.
Phase 3 post-processing runs postprocess_page.py and clean_pdf2md_output.py in sequence.
postprocess_page.py applies deterministic cleanup rules to raw VLM output artifacts.
clean_pdf2md_output.py strips repeated page headers and footers based on content patterns.
Keeping cleanup tools separate lets Phase 4 reuse header and footer stripping on the assembled document.
Partial success allows a PDF with failed pages to assemble available pages instead of requiring a full rerun.
Placeholder insertion makes failed pages visible and preserves targeted rerun capability.
Placeholder-containing output is degraded because downstream consumers may get prose gaps.
The degraded-output policy requires human review and recommends rerunning failed pages before downstream use.
ASSET_MODE prose keeps the Phase 2 asset JSON and runs deterministic materialization in Phase 3.5.
Asset-enabled mode has no extra VLM dispatch because the merged skill already wrote per-page asset JSON.
Asset materialization assigns stable IDs, crops rasters, renders XLSX from table_data, anchors Markdown references, aggregates a manifest, and validates links.
ASSET_MODE none ignores the merged skill asset JSON with no extra cost relative to text-only mode.
Stable asset IDs use page-local identity with doc stem, page number, asset kind, and ordinal.
Caption slugs are advisory filename suffixes rather than asset identity.
Asset-enabled v1 appends an Extracted Page Assets block instead of treating existing inline mentions as filesystem-backed asset references.

PDF2MD is Step 0 of the DOMAIN pipeline and produces Markdown consumed by DOMAIN_DECOMP at Step 1.
